# Eject Disk

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Eject's the provided disk from the machine.

## Syntax

~~~~text
ejectDisk(disk: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
ejectDisk(disk: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
